long_biography.plain_text:
Christian Imbusch remains closely involved in property development on Mallorca. A 2024 documentary followed him through several villa builds on the island, where he inspected work and kept close track of each project's progress.

The projects illustrate a hands-on approach to residential development. Imbusch personally checks building progress while his wider business covers the purchase, sale, letting and management of property. Television appearances brought his working style into public view years after the company was established. His public role has remained tied to the villa projects and their construction sites.
